name: scoped
description: Scoped - coding agent workers (Claude Code, Copilot ACP, VS Code Web) + API + CLI

scripts.docker:up: npx tsx scripts/worktree-env.ts && docker compose up --build
scripts.docker:up:claude-code: npx tsx scripts/worktree-env.ts && docker compose --profile claude-code --profile report up --build
scripts.docker:up:copilot: npx tsx scripts/worktree-env.ts && docker compose --profile copilot --profile report up --build
scripts.docker:up:vscode-web: npx tsx scripts/worktree-env.ts && docker compose --profile vscode-web up --build
scripts.docker:up:report: npx tsx scripts/worktree-env.ts && docker compose --profile report up --build
scripts.docker:up:all-workers: npx tsx scripts/worktree-env.ts && docker compose --profile claude-code --profile copilot --profile vscode-web --profile report up --build
scripts.docker:up:infra: npx tsx scripts/worktree-env.ts && docker compose up -d mongodb redis azurite
scripts.docker:up:portal: npx tsx scripts/worktree-env.ts && docker compose --profile portal up --build
scripts.docker:dev: npx tsx scripts/worktree-env.ts && COMPOSE_EXPERIMENTAL_WATCH_POLL=1 docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml up --build --watch
scripts.docker:dev:claude-code: npx tsx scripts/worktree-env.ts && COMPOSE_EXPERIMENTAL_WATCH_POLL=1 docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml --profile claude-code --profile report --profile portal up --build --watch
scripts.docker:dev:copilot: npx tsx scripts/worktree-env.ts && COMPOSE_EXPERIMENTAL_WATCH_POLL=1 docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml --profile copilot --profile report --profile portal up --build --watch
scripts.docker:dev:portal: npx tsx scripts/worktree-env.ts && COMPOSE_EXPERIMENTAL_WATCH_POLL=1 docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml --profile portal up --build --watch
scripts.docker:dev:all: npx tsx scripts/worktree-env.ts && COMPOSE_EXPERIMENTAL_WATCH_POLL=1 docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml --profile claude-code --profile copilot --profile report --profile portal up --build --watch
scripts.docker:dev:build: npx tsx scripts/worktree-env.ts && docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml --profile claude-code --profile copilot --profile report --profile portal build
scripts.docker:down: npx tsx scripts/worktree-env.ts && docker compose --profile claude-code --profile copilot down
scripts.docker:build: npx tsx scripts/worktree-env.ts && docker compose --profile claude-code --profile copilot --profile report build
scripts.test:copilot:concurrent: concurrently -n req1,req2 -c blue,green "pnpm cli submit -m 'Request 1: Say hello' -w coder-acp-copilot -u $API_ENDPOINT" "pnpm cli submit -m 'Request 2: Say goodbye' -w coder-acp-copilot -u $API_ENDPOINT"
scripts.test:all-coders: concurrently -n copilot,claude -c blue,magenta "pnpm cli submit -m 'Hello from Copilot test' -w coder-acp-copilot -u $API_ENDPOINT" "pnpm cli submit -m 'Hello from Claude test' -w coder-acp-claude-code -u $API_ENDPOINT"
